capabilities: Converse with the Claudian agent by voice, with spoken replies and turn detection
Dictate to the clipboard or drive Claudian's inline edit by holding a hotkey and speaking
Read the current note aloud with editor highlighting and scrolling
Capture quick notes like 'note to self' into the daily note without invoking the agent
Configure transcription and speech engines, including OpenAI, Groq, and local Whisper servers
disambiguation: Not a standalone dictation or text-to-speech plugin; it only works alongside the Claudian agent plugin.
extras: Requires Claudian 2.3.30+; streaming transcription is billed while the microphone is open, so sessions auto-end after 45 seconds of silence by default. Pre-releases available via BRAT. An earlier feat/public-chat-api fork of Claudian is no longer needed.
intentEvidence: A companion plugin for Claudian: it owns the microphone, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech, and drives Claudian through its plugin API
problem: The Claudian agent plugin has no audio support of its own, so there is no way to talk to the agent hands-free or hear its replies spoken.

relations.evidence: A companion plugin for Claudian: it owns the microphone, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech, and drives Claudian through its plugin API
Transcription defaults to OpenAI's Realtime API in transcription mode (gpt-4o-mini-transcribe)

summary: Voice interface for the Claudian agent plugin: spoken conversation, hold-to-talk dictation, voice-driven inline edits, and reading notes aloud.
